activity_summary: The morning kept the fourth act cut. The king goes off at Flint a king and comes on a prisoner, and York reports the unmaking. The deposition is not played. Pope will not invent one in the garden. Nick's high line has a grain in it, not a break, and you told him to keep it. The glass may sit on the throne until half past one, as Richard's habit, and it is not a restoration. After Gaunt you are at the door. You cannot be the dead man and the witness in the same breath.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the cut, and took the door as his place after Gaunt.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Accepted the hole where the crown changes offstage, and kept the glass as a habit.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Called the fourth act a report, and kept the parliament off the plot.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Named the grain, and was told not to force it back to a boy's note.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Refused to grow a deposition out of a garden.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Heard the grain, looked down, and would not have it forced.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in The cut fourth act

facets.activity: Let Richard keep the glass until Garnish's hour

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: I lose a crown in the tiring-house, Will.

quotes.text: It is not a break. It is a grain.
